verdict: CLOSING — brand-new entrants could still break out through Jan 2026 (Economic Historian, created 2026-01-01, reached 23k subs/1.6M views; ECONOMY HISTORIAN, created 2025-11, reached 18k subs/1.4M views), but every exact-format entrant I could find from Mar-Jun 2026 has near-zero traction, both recent successes show decaying recent-upload views, and YouTube's Jul-2025 'inauthentic content' policy plus the Jan/Feb-2026 enforcement wave against faceless AI channels is actively raising the bar on exactly this format.

evidence_summary: METHOD AND ITS LIMITS: search.list was quota-blocked, so discovery came from (a) web searches on format-typical video titles, then videos.list→channels.list to resolve channel IDs and creation dates, and (b) probing ~36 plausible niche handles via channels.list forHandle (which surfaced failures the algorithm and search engines never show: When Nations Fall, Dead Nations, Breaking Borders-class channels, Economic Ruins, NATIONSONEDGE). All numbers in the cohort table are API-verified (channels.list / playlistItems.list / videos.list, 2026-07-12). HONEST CAVEAT: this discovery method is itself survivorship-biased — web search only surfaces channels that got distribution, and handle-guessing only finds failures with guessable names. The true failure denominator is certainly much larger than the 5-6 dead channels I found; treat my ~50% visible failure rate as a floor, not an estimate. KEY FINDINGS: (1) Cold starts still worked at least through Jan 2026 — two anonymous faceless channels created Nov 2025 and Jan 2026 each cleared 1.4-1.6M lifetime views with individual videos at 100-380k. (2) Every exact-format entrant found from Mar-Jun 2026 is at or near zero (19 subs, 2 subs, 0 subs), and both recent successes show sharply weaker June-July uploads — consistent with either a tightening algorithm or normal hit-variance, but the direction is down. (3) The niche's flagship, Fall of Nations, quietly exited neutral collapse-history into anti-Islam ragebait in 2026 — its collapse-format videos now do 16-48k while ragebait does 200k-1.7M; the category leader's own revealed preference is evidence the pure format's ceiling fell. (4) Platform risk is real and format-specific: YouTube's Jul-15-2025 'inauthentic content' policy and a Jan-2026 enforcement wave (16 channels, ~4.7B views, ~$10M/yr ad revenue removed, per industry press) target mass-produced faceless AI explainers, and 2026 quality updates reportedly penalize AI narration over generic images. An Aug-2026 entrant is launching into the crackdown, not before it.

answers.question: (1) Census of collapse-history channels created in the last 6-9 months — is the algorithm still distributing to brand-new entrants?
answers.answer: Partially, and decreasingly. In the 6-9-month window (Oct 2025-Jul 2026) I verified two genuine breakouts: ECONOMY HISTORIAN (created 2025-11-11; 18.1k subs, 1.39M views, 30 videos; hits to 380k views in Feb-Apr 2026) and Economic Historian (created 2026-01-01; 23.3k subs, 1.6M views; hits to 106k in Mar 2026, though it drifted into finance listicles and its July uploads do ~700 views). Against them: Dead Nations (Mar 2026, 2 subs), Breaking Borders (Apr 2026, 19 subs, 1,760 views on 10 exactly-on-format videos), NATIONSONEDGE (Jun 2026, 0 uploads), When Nations Fall (Aug 2025, 41 views), Economic Ruins (567 lifetime views despite uploading into 2026). So the algorithm demonstrably still cold-started this format as late as January 2026, but I found NO post-February-2026 entrant with any traction, and the two successes' own recent uploads are decaying. The visible success rate in my census is roughly 2-3 of 9 entrants, and the invisible failure pool is larger — the exemplars' 100-200k-sub outcomes are the far right tail, not the expected case.

answers.question: (2) Is 'Dr. Jonathan Tam' actually faceless or a credentialed on-camera persona?
answers.answer: Neither pure archetype — and that matters for copyability. Production is faceless-style: the channel About (API-verified) explicitly says videos are hybrid AI-assisted productions where 'AI visuals bring history, society, and culture to life where no footage exists,' i.e., voiceover + AI imagery, not on-camera hosting; web coverage likewise describes AI-assisted production rather than an on-camera host (I did not find evidence he appears on camera; confidence medium — based on channel metadata and web coverage, not frame-by-frame video review). But the BRAND is a named, verifiable, credentialed human: real person, Oxford sociology PhD, Warner Bros. Games research background, LinkedIn profile (Dr. Jon Tam Media Inc.), and the About leads with 'I'm Jon.' So his cold-start success is NOT evidence that an anonymous faceless channel gets the same treatment — his authority positioning (credential in the channel name), topical focus (East Asia socioculture, where he has lived experience), and disclosed-AI transparency are moats a generic Aug-2026 faceless entrant cannot copy.

answers.question: (3) Does demand extend past marquee cases (Japan demographics, hyperinflation) to long-tail country/crisis cases?
answers.answer: Yes, but with brutal variance and a marquee premium. API-verified long-tail datapoints on ECONOMY HISTORIAN (18k subs): 'Why Cuba Is The Last Soviet Parasite' 77,715 views; 'Why Australia Is The New Argentina' 72,342; 'Why Canada Will Be Poorer Than Mexico by 2030' 113,852; 'Why New Zealand Will Soon Belong to Australia' 26,858 — all far above the channel's sub count, proving the algorithm will push non-marquee country cases. Dr. Tam's long-tail cultural-economic cases also perform ('80,000 Geisha Became 250' 12.8k; 'Kyoto Lost 7 Million Japanese Visitors' 17.3k). BUT the same channels' long-tail misses cluster at 1-7k views ('Venezuela: The First Capitalist Soviet Union' 2,634; 'The Mistake That Broke Germany' 6,954; 'Why Fixing France Is So Hard' 2,359) — roughly a 1-in-3 hit rate — and the biggest numbers still come from marquee-adjacent framings (France/EU 380k and 161k; Kurzgesagt's marquee 'SOUTH KOREA IS OVER' and Economics Help's population-collapse videos at 240-320k). Long-tail demand exists; a channel built ONLY on long-tail cases should expect most videos to do low-thousands with occasional 30-100k breakouts.

answers.question: (4) Ad-suitability: any creator reports of limited ads on politically-charged collapse content?
answers.answer: I found NO first-person creator report specific to this exact niche (honest gap — Reddit searches returned nothing usable), but three converging lines of indirect evidence say ad-suitability risk is material: (a) industry monetization guides (MilX, Mediacube, Lenostube 2026 adpocalypse timeline) state that controversial news, tragedy, and extreme political conflict content triggers limited ads because brands avoid conflict adjacency — collapse content about named countries/religions/wars sits squarely in that category; (b) the platform-level crackdown is documented: YouTube's Jul-15-2025 'inauthentic content' policy and a Jan-2026 enforcement wave that removed 16 faceless AI channels (~4.7B views, ~$10M/yr ad revenue, per ScaleLab/Hollywood Reporter coverage), plus reported 2026 quality updates penalizing AI narration over stock imagery; (c) revealed-preference evidence from the niche leader: Fall of Nations' 2026 pivot from neutral economic-collapse history into anti-Islam ragebait (verified via its last 25 uploads) chases exactly the content class most exposed to limited ads and channel strikes — a fragile revenue base an advertiser-safe entrant would be competing against on CPM-hostile terrain. Treat ad-suitability as unverified-but-likely risk: plan for limited ads on any video naming a living country's political failure.
